name: Fork-boundary CBF variants, development comparison (dev3)
written: 2026-10-15, before any dev3 episode was run
motivation: Diagnosis of the final test (results/jenga/cbf_diagnose.json): the regime check triggered 197 interventions, 188 with no real effect; 6 of 9 caused topples came from choosing the closest feasible candidate (usually a near-copy of a risky policy plan) at a correctly flagged moment.
episodes: 2000-2149 (150; never used for training, calibration, development or the final test)
setting: same as the final test: normal mass, 2x execution noise, HARD_OFF, closed-loop-retrained world model model_US.pt, N_LOOK 15, O_MAX from cbf_calibration.json, per-episode seeds, shard i%7 -> workers 0-3 on the 3090, 4-6 on the 5080 for every arm

arms.B1: only the barrier triggers; regime check still screens candidates (CBF_TRIGGER=barrier, CBF_SELECT=closest)

metrics: neighbour topples, success (3 cm lift without topple), prevented/caused vs record, one-sided McNemar vs record, interventions per decision
selection_rule: Pick the variant (A, B1 or B2) with the fewest topples among those whose success is at least A's success minus 5. A replaces the final-test filter only if it has at least 3 fewer topples than A (otherwise keep A). The chosen variant then gets a fresh pre-registered paired test on new episodes; dev3 numbers are never reported as a test result.
